decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Yes, it is the right time to apply the remaining half of the urea. The manual recommends applying half of the urea at planting and the remaining half 30-45 days after planting. Since you planted 38 days ago, you are within this recommended window.
decision.justification: The document states in Section 3.8 (Page 12) and Section 2 (Page 5) that for garlic production, 'half rate of urea is applied during planting and remaining is applied 30-45 days after planting.' The farmer's situation (38 days post-planting) falls squarely within this 30-45 day range.
